declared.amendment: run 1 fired its kill (read-table: A passed, G2 failed) -- cause: the previously derived places were quoted free at a markless page and stole the search; fix A: derived places paid unless exact (offers untouched). Run 2 fired the same kill -- cause: finalize itself had been priced at 3 while a markless page's working hand needs its shipped finalize price; fix B: finalize keeps its shipped price until a mark exists. Both fixes change PRICES only; no offer ever changed. Runs 1 and 2 are preserved in the receipt beside run 3, which is the adjudicating run under this declared protocol; the final verdict is computed on run 3 and the two earlier kills are reported honestly
declared.kill: any verdict regression on REGRESSION_TASKS (A passes, G2 fails); a pass_primary page whose ceiling A reaches and G2 does not; or find-midpoint at the even seed passing in A or D2 while G2 fails
declared.pass_full_reward: find-midpoint at the pre-declared even-parity seed (the lowest seed >= 1061 at which both coordinate sums of the two marks are even) passes in G2 with an EXACT_* rule while A and D2 fail it -- full reward exactly where the actuator can express the optimum
declared.pass_primary: on circle-center and right-angle at seed 1060: G2's candidate set reaches the arithmetic ceiling of the reachable integer lattice within 1e-3 (the optimum lies half-way between lattice points) and beats A's candidate set there; the ceiling window is a measurement instrument derived from the page's stated geometry and the hand never receives it
declared.report: spend drift on REGRESSION_TASKS, honestly, whether or not it favors G2
